pr_title: Add Alibaba Cloud AnalyticDB Spark Support
pr_body:
This PR aims to add Alibaba Cloud AnalyticDB Spark[1] support.
1. implement custom operator/hook/sensor for AnalyticDB Spark.
2. enable users to schedule AnalyticDB Spark Batch/SQL applications by DAGs.
3. AnalyticDB Spark hooks provides log/Web UI url/application status for users.

[1]: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/analyticdb-for-mysql/latest/spark-offline-application-development
closes: #31738

Alibaba Cloud AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition (V3.0) uses the same Spark development method for batch applications and SQL applications.[1]

We want to provide operator/hook/sensor to enable Airflow users using AnalyticDB Spark.

reference:
[1] https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/analyticdb-for-mysql/latest/spark-offline-application-development
